values.note: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead, same day included; DEC's 2026 summary sets a 1-night reservation minimum here. A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register 2-9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented.

values.note: The Little Sand Point Loop of DEC's Piseco Lake Campground (98 sites in all per DEC): ReserveAmerica sells 56 campsites in the loop plus 2 group sites, 6 listed at 30 ft, 15 at 20 ft, 4 at 10 ft, the rest with no length. The other loop, Point Comfort, has 34 campsites including two listed at 40 ft and five 20-ft pull-throughs.

note: DEC (Adirondack): the Little Sand Point Loop of Piseco Lake Campground, hilly and wooded with conifers and hardwoods; many lakefront sites. Boat launch; motorboats allowed. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $20 + $5 non-resident and the 1-night reservation minimum (DEC 2026 summary, as 'Piseco Lake'), phone 518-548-7585, opening May 14 2027, no electric, showers, dump, 30-ft max in this loop. Changed site count 78 -> 56 (RA's Little Sand Point Loop). Added season close 09-05 (Labor Day), ReserveAmerica 9-month window and 14-night max, flush toilets, water spigots. Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: Name: DEC and ReserveAmerica publish this as 'Piseco Lake Campground' (parkId 11135), with the Little Sand Point Loop and the Point Comfort Loop; there is no separately bookable Little Sand Point campground. Suggest 'Piseco Lake Campground (Little Sand Point Loop)', or renaming to Piseco Lake Campground and re-pinning to cover both loops (Point Comfort has the two 40-ft sites).

Season note (manual, 2026-10-20) says 'Reservable through Sep 5, 2027 (Labor Day weekend); DEC posts no later date.' DEC's 2026 summary does post a close: 'Piseco Lake ... May 15 ... Sept 7' (Labor Day 2026). Suggest: 'Closes on Labor Day: Sep 7 in 2026 (DEC summary), Sep 5 in 2027 (ReserveAmerica).'

Weak waterfront lead: ReserveAmerica tags every campsite 'Near Water - no', while the entry is lakefront. Probably RA's default tag (it does this at every DEC campground checked); listed only because it is a booking-engine water claim contrary to ours.
